_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Nekk d Umari {player_id} deg urar n LinsOfAction.
Isiggen-ik d '{side}', isiggen n umarir nniḍen d '{other}'.
Tawala n uɛiwed: `[b1b3]` (akkat n tazwara - akkat n tazzwara). Aɛiwed amahaluz yetturar s uɣerbaz, neɣ s uɣerbaz nniḍen, neɣ s uɣerbaz nniḍen, s wuṭṭun n isiggen (nniḍen) deg wuṭṭun-ik. Tzemreḍ ad tɛiwdeḍ ɣef isiggen-ik, maca ur tzemreḍ ara ad tɛiwdeḍ ɣef isiggen n umarir nniḍen; ad tɛkkeḍ isiggen-nsen.  Ad irbeḥ wakken meṛṛa isiggen-ik d-qqnen ɣer 8 n imaslaḍen.

game_action.captured_suffix: Umarir {player_id} iɛiwed {from} -> {to} iɣdel asekkil n umarir nniḍen.
